title: I love this mattress topper!
text: I love this mattress topper!. It fit the bed well and works well with the sheets.  It is super comfortable if you love soft mattresses.  I love the lavender scent, it's staying after 2 months.  I recommend this topper.  It's fabulous!

product_metadata.title: Lucid 2 Inch Mattress Topper Full – Memory Foam Mattress Topper Full – 5 Zone Lavender Infusion – CertiPur Certified Foam
features: 2 inch thick memory foam mattress topper adds softness and comfort to an existing mattress
Memory foam infused with lavender scent, known for its natural calming and relaxation benefits
Ventilated design for improved breathability; foam is CertiPUR-US certified for highest standards of safety and performance
All three profiles have the same feel, but a thicker topper will result in a deeper sink that cradles your body more than a thinner topper
description: Upgrade your mattress and your life with the pressure-relieving comfort of memory foam and the relaxing scent of lavender. The LUCID 2 Inch Memory Foam Mattress Topper offers a thick comfort layer that distributes weight evenly and conforms to the curves of your body to alleviate aches and pains at common pressure points. Premium, conformable memory foam is infused with lavender, which has long been used to naturally promote calming and relaxation. California King sized mattress topper measures 71" x 83"
